parameters.name: Alias
parameters.description: The alias. The maximum length is 32 characters. This parameter is not required for cross-account backups that are configured based on a resource directory.

parameters.name: CrossAccountRoleName
parameters.description: The name of the RAM role for the account to back up. This parameter is used when you configure a cross-account backup by assuming a RAM role.

parameters.name: CrossAccountType
parameters.description:
The type of cross-account backup. Valid values:

- **CROSS\_ACCOUNT**: Configures a cross-account backup by assuming a RAM role.

- **CROSS\_ACCOUNT\_BY\_RD**: Configures a cross-account backup based on a resource directory.

parameters.name: CrossAccountUserId
parameters.description: The UID of the account to back up.
